title: Principal Lead- Product Data Engineer
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Technical Product Analyst (TPA) plays a pivotal role in an engineering driven delivery model. Unlike traditional Business Systems Analyst roles, this position requires strong technical depth and the ability to directly participate in solution design, data modeling, and implementation readiness.  

The role partners closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Solution Architects, and Platform Engineering teams to ensure clarity, technical feasibility, and executional excellence across initiatives involving cloud data platforms, analytics, and automation.**Key Responsibilities**

**Product \& Requirement Translation**

* Partner with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business outcomes into **technically actionable, build‑ready requirements**
* Decompose epics and features into engineering‑backed user stories with clear acceptance criteria and technical context
* Ensure alignment between product intent, architectural standards, and platform capabilities

**Technical \& Engineering Collaboration**

* Act as a technical conduit between product and engineering teams, ensuring shared understanding of design trade‑offs and constraints
* Participate in solution discussions, architecture reviews, and technical refinement sessions
* Validate requirements against data models, APIs, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure patterns

**Hands‑On Technical Contribution**

* Contribute directly to **data analysis, SQL queries, schema definitions, metadata documentation, and pipeline validation**
* Experience supporting initiatives involving **cloud modernization, cost optimization, or AI enablement**
* Support engineering teams with implementation‑level artifacts such as data contracts, business logic mapping, and quality rules
* Validate delivered solutions through hands‑on testing, data reconciliation, and functional verification

**Data Quality, Reliability \& Automation**

* Define and embed data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and reliability metrics into delivery workflows
* Support automation of validation, monitoring, and reporting wherever feasible
* Partner with engineers to ensure observability, lineage, and governance considerations are addressed early

**Delivery \& Operational Excellence**

* Enable faster, more predictable delivery by reducing ambiguity and rework through high‑quality technical documentation
* Support backlog prioritization with a clear understanding of technical dependencies and delivery risks
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery processes and engineering best practices

**Required Skills \& Experience**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands‑on experience with **SQL** and data analysis across large datasets
* Solid understanding of **cloud data platforms** (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Familiarity with modern data architectures:


	+ Data lakes / Lakehouses
	+ ELT/ETL pipelines
	+ Streaming or batch data processing
* Working knowledge of:


	+ APIs and data integration patterns
	+ Data modeling (conceptual, logical, and physical)
	+ Data quality and reconciliation frameworks (SODA)
* Comfortable working in **Agile / DevOps** delivery models

**Product \& Analytical Skills**

* Ability to connect business objectives to technical implementation details
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to reason through complex data and system interactions
* Experience working with product backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria

**Collaboration \& Communication**

* Proven ability to effectively collaborate with engineering‑heavy teams
* Clear, concise communicator capable of documenting complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
* Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving clarity in ambiguous problem spaces

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **data engineering, analytics engineering, or platform engineering** teams
* Exposure to **automation, orchestration, or CI/CD pipelines**
* Background transitioning from or working alongside traditional BA/BSA roles within modern data teams.

**In\-Office Collaboration**  

We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Full time**Timings**

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, genetic information, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, military status, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, family status or any other basis prohibited by law.*

*We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, speak to your recruiter to discuss how we can support you.*

title: Data Engineering manager
description:
**Experience**

10–15 Years

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Data Engineering Manager with 10–15 years of experience** to lead data engineering initiatives, build scalable data pipelines, manage data lake architecture, and enable real\-time analytics and AI use cases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the data engineering roadmap from streaming ingestion to analytics\-ready data layers.
* Lead real\-time pipelines using **Kafka/MSK, Debezium CDC, and Apache Pinot**.
* Design and maintain **Java/Python\-based** frameworks for ingestion, validation, transformation, and replication.
* Design and manage data lakes using **Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue, Athena, and S3**.
* Define data modeling standards across **Pinot, Redshift, and warehouse layers**.
* Lead orchestration and workflow platforms using **Apache Airflow and Superset**.
* Drive cloud\-native deployments using **ECS/EKS, Docker, Terraform/CDK, and CI/CD**.
* Support ML, analytics, product, and AI initiatives with reliable data solutions.
* Ensure **data quality, observability, lineage, governance, and security** across the data stack.
* Mentor data engineers and promote modern architecture and engineering best practices.

**Required Skills**

* **Real\-Time Data:** Kafka/MSK, Debezium, Event\-Driven Architecture, CDC
* **Data Platforms:** Apache Pinot, Redshift, RocksDB/NoSQL, Apache Iceberg, Athena, AWS Glue
* **Programming:** Java, Python
* **Orchestration:** Apache Airflow, Superset
* **AWS:** S3, IAM, Lambda, Glue, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch
* **Data Architecture:** Data Lakes, Streaming \& Batch Processing, Data Modeling, Parquet, Avro
* **DevOps:** Docker, Terraform/CDK, CI/CD, GitHub Actions

**Good to Have**

* dbt, Trino/Presto, ClickHouse, or Druid.
* Data security, encryption at rest/in transit, GDPR/PCI compliance.
* CloudFormation and advanced DevOps practices.
* Experience with scalable cloud\-native data architectures.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Network Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Monitor network performance and ensure system availability and reliability
* Troubleshoot and resolve network issues to maintain high levels of performance and availability
* Perform routine network maintenance tasks, including software and hardware updates
* Install and configure network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers
* Develop and implement network security measures to protect sensitive data
* Create and maintain documentation for network configurations and troubleshooting steps
* Coordinate with vendors for new systems technologies and manage installations
* Respond to network\-related issues reported by users, offering immediate solutions or escalating as necessary
* Recommend upgrades and improvements based on performance monitoring and trends
* Provide first\-level troubleshooting support for networking issues
* Assist with the configuration and deployment of network hardware and software
* Manage network documentation and maintain updated network schematics
* Collaborate with senior engineers to resolve complex network issues
* Perform routine network maintenance and updates
* Respond promptly to network alerts and service requests
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices related to networking
* Participates in On Call Rotation 24/7
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Any degree with 5\+ years of experience
* Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols
* Experience with network monitoring tools
* Proven solid problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Proven excellent communication and customer service skills
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
